substantiveCommits.message: Preserve Danchi LOD visibility and GI renderer state
Expand Danchi LOD visibility and GI continuity contract
Enforce Danchi LOD visibility and GI state continuity

finding.summary: The existing Danchi LOD proxy generator copied mesh/material, probe anchor, motion-vector/occlusion/sorting state and MaterialPropertyBlocks, but a newly-created proxy still defaulted to active/enabled and did not preserve rendering-layer, Light Probe Proxy Volume, additional vertex streams, MeshRenderer GI authoring state, or baked/realtime lightmap assignment. A retained physical source that was intentionally disabled/inactive could therefore reappear only at LOD1+, and a source using alternate vertex/GI/lightmap state could shade differently during CrossFade.
observedSourceEvidence: CreateProxyRenderer created each proxy GameObject active with a newly-added MeshRenderer enabled by default; source.enabled and source active-in-hierarchy state were not copied.
CreateProxyRenderer did not copy renderingLayerMask or lightProbeProxyVolumeOverride.
CreateProxyRenderer did not copy additionalVertexStreams, receiveGI, scaleInLightmap or stitchLightmapSeams.
CreateProxyRenderer did not copy lightmapIndex/lightmapScaleOffset or realtimeLightmapIndex/realtimeLightmapScaleOffset.
The prior proxy-fidelity QA did not compare any of those states, so formal evidence could not fail closed on these discontinuities.

parentLodGenerator: Copy source MeshRenderer.enabled and effective active-in-hierarchy visibility to each retained LOD proxy so disabled/inactive legacy or alternate geometry cannot reappear at distance.
Copy renderingLayerMask and lightProbeProxyVolumeOverride in addition to the existing light/reflection probe usage and probe anchor state.
Copy additionalVertexStreams so source normals/tangents/colors/UV overrides remain identical across LOD transitions.
Copy receiveGI, scaleInLightmap and stitchLightmapSeams to preserve GI authoring intent.

Copy baked/realtime lightmap index and scale-offset for immediate same-session continuity; do not trust that copy after scene reload because Unity's lightmapping system owns those transient Editor/runtime assignments.
formalQa: danchi_lod_proxy_fidelity_contract.json advanced to schemaVersion 1.1 and now machine-enforces visibility, rendering-layer, LPPV, vertex-stream, GI and runtime-lightmap parity.
QA4K_*, QATemporal_* and QAPreparedTemporal_* pre-cull remains read-only/fail-closed; no repair occurs during formal capture.

Formal validation now rejects renderer-enabled/effective-visibility drift, rendering-layer/LPPV drift, additionalVertexStreams drift, ReceiveGI/scale/stitch drift, and baked/realtime lightmap index or UV scale-offset drift.
Native 3840x2160 and sealed temporal evidence remain mandatory before any Visual Fidelity point can be awarded.
implementation.assetReasoning: No new assembly geometry or material was authored in this run, so manufacture/installation metadata and lookdev are unchanged. This run closes renderer-state continuity for already reconstructed physical assemblies rather than inventing speculative asset detail.

verification.githubCompareBeforeRunRecord: startHead -> 923cd1133bdc7350bcf752e8cf67a7fefc832035 is ahead 3, behind 0; merge-base remains startHead; only UnityProject/Assets/Editor and UnityProject/Assets/QA changed.
verification.apiSurfaceSanityCheck: Unity 6 documentation confirms Renderer.lightmapIndex/lightmapScaleOffset and MeshRenderer ReceiveGI/additionalVertexStreams APIs. Unity also documents that editor/runtime lightmap index/scale-offset assignment is owned by the lightmapping system after scene load, which is why formal pre-cull revalidation is required instead of treating the generation-time copy as durable evidence.

place one retained source under an inactive parent while leaving its proxy active and require FAIL
change one proxy renderingLayerMask or Light Probe Proxy Volume override and require FAIL
replace one proxy additionalVertexStreams reference and require FAIL

change one proxy baked or realtime lightmap index/scale-offset and require FAIL

nextBlocker: A Unity 6000.3.0f1 Runner is required to compile the expanded Renderer/MeshRenderer API usage, rebuild and save/reopen DanchiHighDetail, execute visibility/GI/lightmap failure injections, then capture native 3840x2160 frontal/oblique/grazing stills, 100% construction/material crops and sealed lod_walk_oblique temporal evidence. If Runner/screenshots appear, stop speculative expansion and score/fix the actual rendered evidence first.
